name: codex-pet-panel
description: A floating desktop pet for Codex and Claude Code in VS Code.

codexPet.followActivity.description: Follow local Codex and Claude Code session status in the open workspace. No transcript content is displayed or sent anywhere.

codexPet.desktopEnabled.description: Show the floating desktop pet when this extension starts on macOS. Right-click the desktop pet to tuck it away.

codexPet.checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub for Agent Pet updates once daily (including beta releases). Download and installation require clicking Install update. No chat data is sent.

codexPet.autoReloadAfterUpdate.description: After an Agent Pet in-app update, reload each window when tracked chats have finished, changes are saved and no VS Code task or debug session is active. Includes a 15-second countdown with Later. Unknown/quiet chats and disabled activity tracking postpone reload.
